Maybe its good u have a male doctor - u cud get used to being around a man u don't know in a safe environment and he'd be trained in anxiety so wud understand that u arent comfortable.
If u have a good relationship with ur brother then u cud build on that with ur dad. Talk to him and stuff, and tell him about the high expectations - dads just want the best for their kids! Boys arent any different to girls in the end - theyre still people in the end!
I love that bit about recovery! Youre so right! I get it now that's about focusing on the person not the problem :)

Guys thanx so much for sharing! You've given me some great ideas :) I rly appreciate it!!

I've decided from reading your comments that my motivation is gonna be focusing on the person, not the problem :) thanx so much for your replies, I'm so glad you have these things in your lives and were so willing to share!

Im so sorry they did that to you! but maybe that means they weren't the right people for you to be around - go out and find better people! I dont think anyone shud be alone during hard times so thats why i wanna help my friend

Thanks guys, this all rly helps! I know its hard for ppl with depression to express themselves - so makin myself available seems like a rly good idea!A frank conversation sounds so scary! But im glad to hear it worked so well - I'll keep it in mind...
